problem_type: A paged read is mistaken for a replacement snapshot, so earlier pages disappear from model context
symptom: After look_at_canvas reads the first page and one or more continuation pages, the message sent for the answer replaces the first page and earlier continuation pages with an omission note; the model can see only the last page.
direct_cause: omitSupersededReads keyed reads only by contractId plus semantic input and hard-coded selectedFrom to detect continuations. look_at_canvas intentionally removes that field from semantic input, so page one and every continuation shared one replacement key.
class_root: The shared read replacement boundary had no declared page cursor field and no sequence invariant saying that continuation pages belong to the latest page-one snapshot without replacing one another.
affected_population: Resident Agent turns that page a large canvas selection through look_at_canvas
Any future read verb whose output changes by a declared presentation-only window or segment parameter
Different canvas resources or read scopes that must remain independently replaceable
entry_points: laneHost transform_context calls omitSupersededReads before each model request
read verb declarations provide semantic and presentation parameter ownership
look_at_canvas compact projection emits the first page or a continuation page
internal_only_reason: This is Nomi’s internal model-context and canvas presentation invariant; no dependency or platform decides whether a continuation replaces a snapshot.
invariants: A successful continuation with the declared pageCursorField value > 0 is in the current resource’s latest page-one sequence and does not supersede page one or another continuation.
A new successful page-one read (selectedFrom absent or zero) supersedes every successful page in the prior sequence for the same semantic resource, while other resources remain untouched.

Every read-verb schema parameter is either present in its semantic input or is the declared pageCursorField; the page cursor never leaks into MCP semantic input and its schema is a non-negative integer.
A continuation canvas projection contains only the current selected window and its node details; the first page retains the full canvas projection.

door_reduction.why_not: These doors are distinct shared boundaries: laneHost is the request transform caller; laneSupersededReads owns replacement; VerbDeclaration owns the declaration shape; readVerbs owns read parameter declarations; and projectCanvasForAgent owns the first-page versus continuation projection. The fix preserves each boundary and makes them agree through the declaration metadata and shared transform.

generality_proof: The host invokes one transform for every model request, and the transform derives keys from every read declaration rather than a hand-maintained tool list. The declaration gate checks every read schema parameter, while the sequence algorithm applies uniformly to each semantic resource key; therefore a second read verb or caller cannot silently reintroduce an unclassified presentation parameter or page replacement.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Keep the latest page-one sequence for each semantic resource and omit only reads from older sequences.
Declare which model-facing read parameters are semantic and which are presentation-only.
Render page one as the full canvas and continuations as only the selected window with its node details.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The host is the shared pre-request transform for resident model turns, queued inputs, and restored histories.
The replacement algorithm is centralized here and is driven by the declarations passed by the host.
The lane supplies the complete canonical canvas result and invokes the shared projection for both page one and continuations.
The single-shot planner cannot page and calls the same projection without selectedFrom; its full-canvas presentation remains the page-one path.

recurrence.reason: Any large selection can produce a continuation, and any future read verb can add a presentation-only window unless the declaration boundary rejects the omission.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs electron/agentLane/laneSupersededReads.mts: host transform and replacement owner checked.
rg -n "semanticInputOf|schema:" electron/shared/agentCapabilities/verbs: all read and write declarations checked; readVerbs is the only read declaration owner.
node scripts/door-map.mjs electron/shared/agentCapabilities/canvasReadCompact.ts: lane and storyboard planner projection consumers checked.
electron/capabilityCore/mcpCapabilityProjection.test.ts: external MCP canvas read remains canonical and does not publish selectedFrom.

prevention.invariant: Only a later page-one read replaces an earlier sequence; continuation pages of the current sequence are all retained.
prevention.failure_mode: A malformed or unknown read call is left unchanged; a successful continuation cannot replace a prior page, and a later page-one read replaces the entire prior sequence for that resource.
prevention.strategy: Derive the semantic resource key from the declaration, classify continuations from the declared pageCursorField, and group successful results into page-one epochs before applying omission notes.

legacy_paths.rationale: No legacy caller or stored data path exists. The old single-key replacement behavior is replaced in place by sequence-aware omission; the old repeated full continuation projection is removed in the same canvas projection function.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The invariant is owned by Nomi’s declaration, host transform, and canvas projection; no third-party runtime controls it.

migration: No stored data or MCP contract input changes. Existing transcripts retain their original tool results; the next request applies the new sequence-aware transform. The declared pageCursorField remains a presentation-only internal lane parameter and is not added to canvas.read semantic input.
residual_risks: The real paid model walk remains with the coordinator; this branch runs only the zero-cost rehearsal as required.

If a future read verb has a multi-dimensional continuation shape, it must declare its page cursor and add a class test for its sequence semantics; the current gate catches an unclassified parameter but does not infer arbitrary continuation rules.
A selection changed between pages is still an offset read of the current selection; each page reports its current total, but no cursor pins the selection snapshot.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The lane transform is the earliest shared boundary that controls what the model receives, and the declaration gate proves all read parameters have an explicit owner.
